description: One tournament by its stable id — the tournament_id carried on match objects. Name, tour, surface, indoor, plus host city/country and category where curated. Works on the FREE plan (no card needed).

tournament_id.description: Stable tournament id, as returned by search_tournaments or carried on a match as tournament_id.

name: get_tournament

message.description: Human-readable summary. Identical to the text content, so either half can be used alone.

ok.description: True when the call returned data. False for a tier wall, a missing or rejected key, or an empty result — all of which are normal states with a clear remedy, not failures.

category.description: Tournament category (grand_slam, masters_1000, tour_finals, atp_500, atp_250, wta_1000, wta_500, wta_250, wta_125, challenger, itf, juniors). Set only where the catalogues agree unambiguously — null otherwise, never derived from the name.

city.description: Host city, from a curated table — null where not curated.

country.description: Host country, ISO-3166 alpha-2 — null where not curated.

id.description: Stable tournament id — the same id match objects carry as tournament_id.

surface.description: Court surface: hard, clay or grass.

tour.description: atp, wta, challenger, itf or juniors.

title: Tournament detail
